name: Token 8633 public autoAddLp / autoSwapAndAddToMarketing
summary: The token exposes public autoSwapAndAddToMarketing() and autoAddLp() that spend the token contract's own balances through the router with no caller check, so a flash-loan-skewed pool let the attacker capture those swaps.
